title: storage/pkg/chunked: Fix missing verities in composefs.blob
body:
### Problem
When using composefs/fsverity, hard links and partial images, if I pull an image that is based on another image, i.e. a lot of the files listed in the composefs.blob of the freshly pulled image will be found in "other layers". However, their verity, which are enabled on the destination file is not present in the composefs.blob in the freshly pulled layers.
### Solution
When hard links are in use, try to measure the verity of the destination file and store it in the verity map, that is later used in the dump procedure.
### Test
storage.conf:
```
[storage]
driver = "overlay"
[storage.options.overlay]
use_composefs = "true"
[storage.options.pull_options]
enable_partial_images = "true"
use_hard_links = "true"
convert_images = "true"
```

commands:
```
podman pull docker.io/ubuntu:26.04
podman pull docker.io/jitesoft/ubuntu:26.04
composefs-info dump /var/lib/containers/storage/overlay/<ubuntu-layer>/composefs-data/composefs.blob
composefs-info dump /var/lib/containers/storage/overlay/<jitesoft-layer>/composefs-data/composefs.blob
```

Before change files in the jitesoft blob which are hard linked to files in the ubuntu-layer will have "-" in its verity column. After the change they will have the same verity as they have in the ubuntu blob.
